## Outcome and scope

- User job or affected governance, exact route, owning decision and continuation.

## Evidence for product or media changes

- [ ] Before and after, with the primary task run on the candidate and recoverable failure exercised.
- [ ] Responsive captures, visual comparison, keyboard and accessibility results, performance and applicable export checks.
- [ ] Brand pack, VIS version, verified source hash, rights and intended use resolved for relevant assets.
- [ ] Reviewer assessments and candidate receipt linked. Findings, blockers and rollback recorded.
- [ ] Independent approval and publication authorization recorded when required.

For governance-only changes, link the contract tests and note which adoption steps
remain open. Use the [Frontier Experience Constitution](https://github.com/Starlight-Intelligence/starlight-design-intelligence/blob/main/portfolio/experience-standard.md)
and [candidate review](https://github.com/Starlight-Intelligence/starlight-design-intelligence/blob/main/evals/frontier-experience-review.md).
